structured.answer: After 8 years at 500 ₪ a month the calculator shows about 68,853 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" (48,000 deposited, no tax). For 4 years it has no number for self-employed people: it says there's no calculation yet for taking the money out before 6 years, only that you'd pay tax.

stuck.why: The only number shown was 25,725, sitting over an empty dashed box. The label under it ('אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות...') was half hidden behind the up-arrow button, so at first I almost took it as the fund's value
Empty dotted bars with no number; I had to read the orange note to work out that there's nothing to calculate there
